# MediaPipe Tasks Vision

Vendored from npm `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.21` (Google LLC), Apache-2.0.
Files: unmodified vision_bundle.mjs, SIMD and non-SIMD wasm loaders/binaries.
Source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/v/0.10.21
The existing Apache-2.0 pose_landmarker_lite.task model is reused; no face coordinates are copied into application data.
